question: Should the interface vocabulary gain `mcp` (a remote MCP server reached over HTTPS) and `desktop-app` (a desktop application with no API)?
why: crawler-scraper/octoparse: the hosted template lane is reached through a remote MCP server at https://mcp.octoparse.com and its custom tasks run in a desktop application, so interface holds cli (documented for Free template runs) and unknown, and interface_detail names MCP and the desktop application. In the store at commit 0398f4dc0405, 40 records name MCP in their access text, and 12 records with no known interface term name MCP, a desktop app, a GUI or an extension there: coding-subs/devin, coding-subs/marscode, coding-subs/windsurf, compute/cua-windows, crawler-scraper/octoparse, debrid/coolspeeds-com, debrid/hotdebrid, debrid/telegram-drive-desktop-caamer20, dev-services/zapier, egress/ownserver, email/tuta, storage/fex-net (fr sql over the access column of text_fts). AGENTS.md section 2 rule 12 extends a vocabulary when a value fits no term; a rules session adds both terms and re-reads those 12 records.
